WikiMistakeList.propTypes: { mistakes?: WikiMistakeCardRawProps[] | string[] | string; items?: WikiMistakeCardRawProps[] | string[] | string }
WikiMistakeList.notes: Accepts either 'mistakes' or 'items' prop name (MDX content uses both). Parses with parseMdxProp, transforms string items via transformMistakeString, delegates to WikiMistakeCard. Returns null if parsed array is empty.

WikiMistakeCard.notes: Normalizes 3 MDX conventions into canonical shape (number, title, wrongValue, correctValue, explanation, sourceRef). __index is injected by WikiMistakeList for numbering. Renders a red-header card with 'Students Write' / 'Correct' side-by-side comparison and explanation.

ArticleMedia.notes: Client component. Supports single/carousel/gallery/embed layouts. Placeholder mode vs ready mode. Renders image, YouTube embed, or generic iframe. Carousel shows prev/next controls. suggestedSearchQuery is destructured but unused (prefixed with _).

WrongAnswerBanner.propTypes: WrongAnswerBannerProps (local interface): { fromWrongAnswer: boolean; topicName: string | null }
WrongAnswerBanner.notes: Shown at top of wiki articles when arriving from a wrong answer. Returns null if fromWrongAnswer is false or topicName is null. Renders an orange-bordered alert with 'You answered a question about [topic] incorrectly.'

Tab.propTypes: TabProps (local interface): { label: string; value: string; children: ReactNode }
Tab.notes: Child component of Tabs. label and value are extracted by Tabs parent via React.Children.forEach; the Tab itself just renders children as-is. Must be used as direct children of the Tabs component.

Tabs.propTypes: TabsProps (local interface): { defaultTab?: string; children: ReactNode }
Tabs.notes: Client component. Expects Tab children. Extracts label/value/content from each Tab child. Renders a tab bar with keyboard navigation (ArrowLeft/ArrowRight) and tab panels. Returns null if no valid tabs found.

Mermaid.notes: Client component. Renders Mermaid diagram from chart string. Uses mermaid.render with DOMPurify sanitization. Shows error state with syntax details on failure. Theme-aware (dark/light).

LawCallout.propTypes: LawCalloutProps from @/types/wiki: { code: LawCalloutCode; section?: string; title?: string; children: React.ReactNode }
LawCallout.notes: Renders a color-coded callout for Philippine building/law codes (nbcp, bp344, ra9514, bp220, pd957, irr). code controls border/bg/eyebrow colors from lawConfig map. section appends to eyebrow label. Falls back to muted generic callout for unknown codes.

ElaborativeInterrogation.notes: Client component. Interactive MCQ or open-ended prompt. options can be native array or MDX string (parsed via parseMdxProp). answer and revealText are aliases (resolvedAnswer = answer || revealText). existingResponse restores prior answer state from DB. Tracks analytics via trackEvent. Submits responses via submitEIResponse server action. DOMPurify sanitizes reveal text.

TeachBackPrompt.propTypes: TeachBackPromptProps (local interface): { topicId: string; topicName: string; entryPoint: 'wiki' | 'focus_review' | 'trail'; trailDayId?: string }
TeachBackPrompt.notes: Client component. Multi-phase teach-back flow: prompt -> submitting -> result (gap analysis with correct_points/gaps/factual_errors/revision_prompt) -> revising -> done. Minimum 20 words to submit. Calls submitTeachBack and submitRevision server actions. Can be dismissed.

WikiPre.propTypes: props: any (passthrough — inspects React.Children for mermaid code blocks)
WikiPre.notes: Client component. Acts as a custom <pre> handler for MDX. Inspects children for code elements with className='language-mermaid' and delegates to <Mermaid>. Otherwise renders a standard dark-background <pre> block. Passes through all other props to the <pre> element.

WikiPartHeader.propTypes: WikiPartHeaderProps from @/types/wiki: { partNumber: number | string; title: string; subtitle?: string }
WikiPartHeader.notes: Renders 'Part N' eyebrow in camp-cobalt mono, followed by an h2 title and optional subtitle. partNumber renders as text (supports both number and string like 'I', 'II').

WikiExamTable.propTypes: WikiTableProps from @/types/wiki: { caption?: string; columns: string[]; rows: WikiTableRow[]; hasSourceColumn?: boolean }
WikiExamTable.notes: Renders a styled data table with header row from columns. rows can have isSectionHeader (renders full-width cobalt label row), isMostTested (gold highlight), isChanged (shows WikiChangedPill). Source column hidden on mobile. Returns null if no columns or rows.

WikiChangedPill.propTypes: WikiChangedPillProps (local interface): { oldValue?: string; className?: string }
WikiChangedPill.notes: Renders a small gold pill '⟳ 2024' with a tooltip. If oldValue is provided, tooltip reads 'Changed from {oldValue} in 2013 Illustrated IRR'. className is merged via cn(). Used inside WikiExamTable row cells.

CalloutBox.propTypes: { type: 'most-tested' | 'lea-watch' | 'version-alert'; children: React.ReactNode; dismissible?: boolean; onDismiss?: () => void }
CalloutBox.notes: Backward-compatible alias. Delegates to <Callout variant={type}>. The type values map to eyebrow-style variants in the unified Callout component. WikiCalloutBox.tsx re-exports this as 'WikiCalloutBox'.

Callout.propTypes: CalloutProps (local interface): { variant?: CalloutVariant; title?: string; children: React.ReactNode; className?: string; dismissible?: boolean; onDismiss?: () => void; bordered?: boolean; action?: CalloutAction }
Callout.notes: Unified callout supporting 12 variants: note, warning, tip, example, info, danger, requirement, exam-tip, authority (icon+label layout), and most-tested, lea-watch, version-alert (eyebrow mono-label layout). bordered prop switches to left-border accent style. action renders a link or button at bottom. Dismissible shows X button when dismissible or onDismiss is set. Also exported as named wrappers: Note, Warn, Tip, Example, CalloutBox, AlertBox, ExamTip, AuthorityContent.

Note.notes: Convenience wrapper: <Callout variant='note' .../>. Blue info-style callout with Info icon.

Warn.notes: Convenience wrapper: <Callout variant='warning' .../>. Amber warning callout with Warning icon.

Tip.notes: Convenience wrapper: <Callout variant='tip' .../>. Green tip callout with Lightbulb icon.

Example.notes: Convenience wrapper: <Callout variant='example' .../>. Cobalt example callout with BookOpen icon.

AlertBox.notes: Backward-compatible alias. Delegates to <Callout variant={type}> with default 'info'. No title/dismissible support (minimal compat interface).

ExamTip.notes: Convenience wrapper: <Callout variant='exam-tip' .../>. Target icon, 'Exam Tip' label. Also re-exported from ExamTip.tsx for backward compat.

AuthorityContent.notes: Convenience wrapper: <Callout variant='authority' .../>. Scales icon, 'Legal Authority' label, italic body text.

Accordion.notes: Client component. WikiAccordion.tsx re-exports this. Expects AccordionItem children. When allowMultiple is false (default), injects _index into each AccordionItem for single-open controlled mode. Renders a bordered container with child items.

AccordionItem.propTypes: AccordionItemProps: { title: string; children: ReactNode; _index?: number }
AccordionItem.notes: Used as child of Accordion. _index is injected by parent in controlled mode. Can also be used standalone with localOpen state. Renders a disclosure button with chevron and collapsible content region.

SubjectSnapshot.propTypes: { items: SnapshotItem[] | string } where SnapshotItem = { label: string; value: string; hero?: boolean }
SubjectSnapshot.notes: Renders a compact metadata bar with hero stat + supporting grid. Auto-detects hero item (hero: true, or value contains '%', or label contains 'weight'). Falls back to flat grid if no hero detected. items can be MDX string parsed via parseMdxProp.

RevealBlock.propTypes: RevealBlockProps (local interface): { children: React.ReactNode; prompt?: string; label?: string; blurRadius?: number; defaultRevealed?: boolean }
RevealBlock.notes: Client component. Blurs children content; user drags a slider handle to reveal progressively. Keyboard accessible (Arrow keys, Home/End). Eye/EyeSlash toggle button for quick show/hide. Uses @use-gesture/react for drag interaction. blurRadius defaults to 12px. Touch-friendly with larger handle on mobile.

ProcessFlow.notes: Simple wrapper that styles an <ol> as a timeline with cobalt circle markers. Expects children to be an <ol> with <li> items. Applies extensive CSS via className string for list markers, spacing, and strong text coloring.

PrequestionGate.propTypes: PrequestionGateProps (local interface): { topicId: string; topicName: string; articleSlug?: string; children: ReactNode; onMissedQuestions?: (questionIds: string[]) => void }
PrequestionGate.notes: Client component. Full-screen gate that fetches 3 prequestions on mount. Phases: loading -> questions -> summary -> article. Auto-submits on option select (tap-to-answer). Shows feedback (correct/not quite) with rationale. Summary shows score and missed concepts. Calls onMissedQuestions callback with missed question IDs. Fails open (shows article) on error.

KeyValues.propTypes: { items: KeyValueItem[] | string } where KeyValueItem = { value: string; label: string }
KeyValues.notes: Renders a responsive grid of value/label cards. Font size adapts to value length: >30 chars = 14px medium, >12 = 18px semibold, <=12 = 28px bold. items can be MDX string parsed via parseMdxProp. Returns null if empty.

InlineQuiz.propTypes: InlineQuizProps (local interface): { question: string; options: QuizOption[] | string; rationale: string }
InlineQuiz.notes: Client component. Inline MCQ with cobalt header 'Quick Check'. options can be MDX string parsed via parseMdxProp. Option letters A-F. After selection, shows correct/incorrect styling and rationale text. Single-attempt only (isAnswered gate).

GenericBlock.notes: Passthrough wrapper for AI-hallucinated MDX component names. Renders children in a subtle bordered box so content is visible without crashing the MDX renderer.

SPP206RefServices.notes: No-op stub for self-closing reference tag already inlined in article text. Always returns null.

SPP207RefServices.notes: No-op stub for self-closing reference tag already inlined in article text. Always returns null.

FormulaBlock.propTypes: { label: string; steps: FormulaStep[] | string } where FormulaStep = { variable: string; operator: string; operands: string[]; comment?: string; divides?: boolean; symbol?: '×' | '÷' | '−' | '+' }
FormulaBlock.notes: Renders formula breakdown steps in a styled surface. label renders as mono eyebrow. Each step shows variable (highlight), operator, operands with inline symbols, and optional // comment. steps can be MDX string parsed via parseMdxProp. divides prop defaults operator symbol to '÷'.

ComparisonTable.notes: Wrapper that styles an HTML <table> with cobalt header row, zebra-striped body, and compact cell padding. Expects children to be a <table> with <thead> and <tbody>. Applies CSS via className strings for thead, th, tbody tr:nth-child, td, and td strong styling.

WikiCalloutBox.propTypes: re-exports CalloutBox from ./Callout: { type: 'most-tested' | 'lea-watch' | 'version-alert'; children: React.ReactNode; dismissible?: boolean; onDismiss?: () => void }
WikiCalloutBox.notes: Backward-compatible re-export of CalloutBox as WikiCalloutBox. See CalloutBox entry for details.

WikiAccordion.propTypes: re-exports Accordion from ./Accordion -> @/components/ui/accordion. AccordionProps: { children: ReactNode; allowMultiple?: boolean }
WikiAccordion.notes: Backward-compatible re-export. Also re-exports AccordionItem (props: title, children, _index?). See Accordion and AccordionItem entries for full details.

ExamTip_reExport.propTypes: re-exports ExamTip from ./Callout: { children: React.ReactNode } (variant fixed to 'exam-tip')
ExamTip_reExport.notes: Standalone re-export file for backward compatibility. Simply re-exports ExamTip from ./Callout. The component renders <Callout variant='exam-tip'>. See main ExamTip entry for details.
